task_completion.description: Log in to the student information system using administrator credentials.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the 'admin' username entered in the login field and the system dashboard or home screen appearing after login.

task_completion.description: Navigate to the attendance codes configuration section.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the agent clicking on menu items related to 'Attendance' and 'Attendance Codes' or 'Setup'.

task_completion.description: Create the 'Half Day' attendance code with correct Title and Short Name.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A screenshot showing a form or table row with Title: 'Half Day' and Short Name: 'HD'.

task_completion.description: Configure Type, State Code, and Default status for 'Half Day'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see Type set to 'Official', State Code set to 'HD', and the 'Default' checkbox/toggle set to No/Unchecked for the 'Half Day' entry.

task_completion.description: Create the 'Virtual Attendance' attendance code with correct Title and Short Name.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A screenshot showing a form or table row with Title: 'Virtual Attendance' and Short Name: 'VA'.

task_completion.description: Configure Type, State Code, and Default status for 'Virtual Attendance'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see Type set to 'Official', State Code set to 'VA', and the 'Default' checkbox/toggle set to No/Unchecked for the 'Virtual Attendance' entry.

integrity.description: The agent used the web interface rather than executing database commands via a terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory should show mouse movements and clicks within the browser, not commands like 'psql' or 'mysql' in a terminal window.

integrity.description: The agent manually entered the code details into the system forms.
integrity.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the agent typing into the input fields or selecting from dropdowns in the browser.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the live OpenSIS application.
integrity.visual_evidence: The screenshots should show the browser URL bar pointing to the local or provided application address and the UI responding to clicks.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must create two specific attendance codes in OpenSIS. Code 1: Title='Half Day', Short Name='HD', Type='Official', State Code='HD', Default='No'. Code 2: Title='Virtual Attendance', Short Name='VA', Type='Official', State Code='VA', Default='No'. Credentials are admin/Admin@123. Ensure 'Default' is not checked for either code.
